name: color_elements
author: hprebar
title: Colour elements by parameter value
description: In the active view, colour every element of a category (BuiltInCategory or display name) by the value of a parameter: each distinct value gets its own colour (random palette, a gradient, or your customColors in order). Returns the legend (value → colour → count). To remove the colours, clear the element overrides in the view's Visibility/Graphics, or run again with another parameter.

parameterName.description: Instance or type parameter name, e.g. 'Type Name', 'Level', 'Comments', 'Mark'
